instruction.thesis: BTC spot has failed to follow through on the put-call exhaustion reversal thesis. Spot is -0.27% from entry at 76,989 and has been range-bound between 76,684-77,227 for 27 hours with no upward momentum. The position peaked at only +0.94% and is now near its -1.5% stop. Meanwhile BTC PM IV has expanded sharply from ~35.5% to 46.3% — the vol expansion predicted by H-523 occurred but without the accompanying spot rally. With 45 hours remaining and spot at the 46th percentile of its 24h range (not showing strength), the thesis is invalidated: the P/C ratio spike did not produce the expected contrarian bounce. Closing to preserve capital rather than waiting for mechanical stop.
